faq.q: What does an AI TikTok ads generator do?
faq.a: It turns a product photo or link into a TikTok-style video ad with an AI actor, voice, and captions. You can make it without filming.

faq.q: How long does an AI TikTok ad take?
faq.a: You can make a TikTok-ready ad in a few minutes. Add a product photo or link, choose an actor and voice, then download the video.

faq.q: Which tool can make TikTok videos for my products?
faq.a: AIVideosUGC makes vertical TikTok-style ads from your product photo or link. Add an AI actor, voice, and captions without hiring a creator.

faq.q: Can AI make TikTok ads in my brand colors?
faq.a: Yes. Choose colors, fonts, and a voice that match your shop. You can make several versions while keeping the same brand look.

faq.q: Can a product link become a TikTok video ad?
faq.a: Yes. Paste your product link to bring in its photos and details. Choose a vertical style, actor, and voice, then review the video.

faq.q: Can I match my TikTok ad to my brand?
faq.a: Yes. Choose brand colors, fonts, voice, and words that fit your shop. You can make several versions without losing a consistent look.

faq.q: Can AI TikTok ads work better than filmed ads?
faq.a: They can, but results depend on your product, offer, and audience. Make several versions quickly and compare their sales in your TikTok ad account.

faq.q: Can AI tailor TikTok ads to different audiences?
faq.a: Yes. Make versions with different actors, words, and voices for each audience. Use your TikTok ad results to see which version works.

faq.q: Why use AI to make TikTok ads?
faq.a: You can make TikTok ads in minutes without creator fees or filming. Try different openings and voices to keep your campaign fresh.
